screens.screen: home (sections: newest / oldest / most viewed, horizontal link cards)
filter list ('مشاهدة المزيد' of a section)

notes: App title in code is 'قروباتي' (group-links directory on Firestore, Material 3, green primary, green[100] cards). No custom font in the repo, so the system Arabic font is used. The grey boxes labelled 'مساحة إعلانية' are the app's own AdMob banner slots (300x250 on home/add form, 320x50 on the list) drawn as neutral placeholders instead of real ads. Type pills show the code's own values (WhatsApp / Facebook / Twitter / Other) as text only. Relative times follow the app's formatter (e.g. 'منذ 5 شهر'). Home is drawn for a normal visitor (no admin delete buttons). Group names and view counts are sample data.
